subject: Barcelona's Alejandro Balde: wanted by United and Liverpool, 40 million euros mentioned, Deco says no sale
title: Balde: 40 million and a bench seat

lines.vo: Forty million euros, five substitute appearances. Barcelona still say no.
Manchester United and Liverpool are both linked with Alejandro Balde, the Barcelona left-back. Those two agreeing is rare.
ESPN says a deal could be around forty million euros. Barcelona prefer a permanent sale.
Juventus want a loan. Deco says Barcelona will not sell unless Balde asks to leave.
Goal counts one hundred and seventy-three appearances since 2021. He has not started any of his five this season. Best seat in the house.
Wanted by two Premier League giants, and still waiting for a start. Now that is a plot twist.
